text: メールでも　かって　あいつに　たよりでも　だすかな…

structure.jp: メールでも　かって
structure.en: buy some Mail or something and

structure.jp: あいつに　たよりでも　だすかな…
structure.en: maybe send that guy a letter or something...

patterns.name: 〜でも (or something)
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing makes it a loose suggestion, 'or something like that'. メールでも = 'some Mail or something'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end is thinking out loud, 'maybe I will'. だすかな = 'maybe I'll send one'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions in order, like 'and then'. メールでも　かって = 'buy some Mail and'.
